name: music-to-video
title: 将音乐曲目转换为视频
description: Get music-synced video ready to post, without touching a single slider. Upload your audio files (MP3, WAV, AAC, FLAC, up to 200MB), say something like "turn my music track into a visual video with synced animations and beat drops highlighted", and download 1080p MP4 when it's done. Built for musicians and content creators who move fast and want to share audio tracks as visual videos without manual editing.
title_en: Music to Video — Convert Music Tracks into Videos
